references.text: David expresses deep sorrow over betrayal by a close friend, which mirrors the disciples' grief and shock upon hearing that one of them will betray Jesus.
This verse in Matthew parallels Mark 14:19, where the disciples ask Jesus if they are the one who will betray him.
Luke gives a similar description of the event, where the disciples ask which among them will betray Jesus.
John also describes this event, where Jesus announces that one of the disciples will betray him, causing great unrest among them.
